Coram:
 Hon'Ble Ms. Justice Rekha Palli
 Order

% 20.04.2023  CM APPL. 19692/2023 -Ex 1. Exemption allowed, subject to all just exceptions.
2. The application stands disposed of.
3.

The present appeal preferred by the driver of the offending vehicle under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicle Act seeks to assail the award dated 24.12.2022 passed by the learned Motor Accidents Claims Tribunal insofar as it grant recovery rights in favour of the respondent no.1.
4.
Learned counsel for the appellant submits that the learned Tribunal has failed to appreciate that the appellant had a valid training certificate to drive a HMV with hazardous goods.

It could,
therefore, not be said that there was any breach of terms and conditions of the insurance policy.
Learned counsel for the respondent no.1 accepts notice.

6. Taking into account the limited ground taken by the appellant, no notice is required to be issued to the respondent nos.2 to 5, who have in any event as per the impugned award received the Tufani Yadav vs New India Assurance Co. Pvt. Ltd And Ors on 20 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/83904570/
1 compensation from the insurer.
7. List for consideration on 06.10.2023.
